sentences.en: The death toll from a mass shooting targeting Muslims in New Zealand rose from 49 to 50 over
sentences.zh: 周末期间，新西兰一起针对穆斯林的严重枪击事件死亡人数从49人上升至50人，

sentences.en: the weekend, after officials found another body at the Al-Nur Mosque, where most of the deaths occurred.
sentences.zh: 此前官员在努尔清真寺发现了另一具遗体，大多数遇难者都是在那里丧生的。

sentences.en: Kevin Roos on why this attack was made by and for the internet.
sentences.zh: 凯文·罗斯将探讨为何这次袭击是由互联网制造并为互联网而生的。

sentences.en: It's Monday, March 18th.
sentences.zh: 今天是3月18日，星期一。

sentences.en: Farid, would you mind just telling us one more time about what happened at the, in the mosque?
sentences.zh: 法里德，你介意再跟我们讲一遍清真寺里发生了什么吗？

sentences.en: Uh, when shooting started, it started from the hallway.
sentences.zh: 呃，枪声响起时，是从走廊开始的。

sentences.en: So I could hear.
sentences.zh: 所以我能听到。

sentences.en: So, to, to, to, to, to, to, to, to, to, to, to, to, to, to.
sentences.zh: 所以，就，就，就，就，就，就，就，就，就，就，就，就，就，就。

sentences.zh: 然后一个弹匣打完了。

sentences.en: Then he revealed again and came back again.
sentences.zh: 接着他又换了弹匣，又回来了。

sentences.en: And I saw all the, all the plastering coming down from the wall and the ceiling.
sentences.zh: 我看到墙上和天花板上的灰泥全都掉了下来。

sentences.en: OK.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: And that was when I knew it was a blind shot.
sentences.zh: 那时我就知道那是盲目扫射。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: OK.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.zh: 所以，就在靠近的时候。

sentences.zh: 他还活着。

sentences.zh: 当他向我射击时，这里有个围栏，

sentences.zh: 这里，他当时在向我射击，或者躲在这里，我来到这里，发现这里有把枪，还有一具尸体。

sentences.en: OK.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So, you came out this way.
sentences.zh: 所以你是从这边出来的。

sentences.zh: 我现在感觉，我把故事重复了一点点。

sentences.zh: 但这是个值得一说的好主意。

sentences.en: Over the weekend, through dozens of interviews with survivors, a story began to emerge of what happened on Friday inside the mosques in Christchurch.
sentences.zh: 周末期间，通过对幸存者的数十次采访，周五发生在基督城清真寺内的事情开始浮出水面。

sentences.en: Was that your regular mosque or were you visiting that mosque?
sentences.zh: 那是你常去的清真寺，还是你当时正好在那儿？

sentences.en: Regular mosque.
sentences.zh: 常去的清真寺。

sentences.en: The shooting began at the Al Noor Mosque, where Farid Ahmad and his wife Humsah, who had moved to New Zealand from Bangladesh, were attending afternoon prayer.
sentences.zh: 枪击事件始于努尔清真寺，法里德·艾哈迈德和他的妻子胡姆萨当时正在那里参加下午的祈祷，他们是从孟加拉国搬到新西兰的。

sentences.en: The ladies' room was on the right-hand side.
sentences.zh: 女宾室在右手边。

sentences.en: So, all the ladies were there.
sentences.zh: 所以，所有的女士都在那里。

sentences.en: And my wife is always a leading person for ladies.
sentences.zh: 我的妻子一直是女士们的领头人。

sentences.en: She had a philosophy.
sentences.zh: 她有一种人生哲学。

sentences.en: She always used to tell me,
sentences.zh: 她过去常对我说，

sentences.en: I don't want to hold any position.
sentences.zh: 我不想担任任何职位。

sentences.en: And I want to prove that you don't need to have any position to help people.
sentences.zh: 我想证明，不需要任何职位也能帮助他人。

sentences.en: She was like a magnet.
sentences.zh: 她就像磁铁一样。

sentences.en: And exactly the same thing happened.
sentences.zh: 事情也确实如此。

sentences.en: The shooting started.
sentences.zh: 枪声响起。

sentences.en: She started instructing several ladies and children to get out.
sentences.zh: 她开始指挥几位女士和孩子撤离。

sentences.en: And she was screaming, come this way, hurry up, this and that.
sentences.zh: 她在大喊，往这边走，快点，这个那个的。

sentences.en: You know, she was doing all these things.
sentences.zh: 你知道，她当时在做所有这些事。

sentences.en: And then she took many children and ladies into a safeguarding.
sentences.zh: 然后她把许多孩子和女士带到了安全的地方。

sentences.en: Then she was coming back, checking about me because I was on the wheelchair.
sentences.zh: 接着她又折返回来，查看我的情况，因为我坐在轮椅上。

sentences.en: Do you mind me asking why you're in the wheelchair?
sentences.zh: 你不介意我问一下你为什么坐轮椅吧？

sentences.en: I was run over by a car.
sentences.zh: 我被车撞了。

sentences.en: He was a drunk driver.
sentences.zh: 肇事者是个酒驾司机。

sentences.en: And it was 1998 and it happened.
sentences.zh: 那是1998年发生的事。

sentences.en: I'm sorry.
sentences.zh: 我很抱歉。

sentences.en: It's okay.
sentences.zh: 没关系。

sentences.en: So she went out of the mosque and then she came back in?
sentences.zh: 所以她走出了清真寺，然后又折返回来了？

sentences.en: Yeah, she was coming back.
sentences.zh: 是的，她当时正在折返。

sentences.en: And once she was approaching the gate, then she was shot.
sentences.zh: 当她快走到门口时，就被枪击中了。

sentences.en: She came back in to fetch you?
sentences.zh: 她是折返回来找你的吗？

sentences.en: Farid learned hours later that Humsah was one of the 42 people police say were killed at the mosque.
sentences.zh: 法里德几小时后得知，胡姆萨是警方称在清真寺遇难的42人之一。

sentences.en: So she was busy with saving lives, you know, forgetting about herself.
sentences.zh: 所以她当时忙着救人，你知道，完全顾不上自己。

sentences.en: And that's what she is.
sentences.zh: 这就是她。

sentences.en: She always has been like this.
sentences.zh: 她一直都是这样。

sentences.en: Six minutes after firing the first shot, and as police raced toward Al Noor Mosque, the shooter drove to a second mosque, the Linwood Mosque, four miles eaSt.
sentences.zh: 在开出第一枪六分钟后，当警察赶往努尔清真寺时，枪手开车前往四英里外的第二座清真寺——林伍德清真寺。

sentences.en: Tell me, I'm sorry, what was your name?
sentences.zh: 请告诉我，抱歉，你叫什么名字？

sentences.en: Abdul Aziz.
sentences.zh: 阿卜杜勒·阿齐兹。

sentences.en: And the mosque that you go to, is it mixed, Pakistani?
sentences.zh: 你去的那座清真寺，是混合的吗，巴基斯坦人？

sentences.en: I mean, that mosque, who was there that day?
sentences.zh: 我是说，那座清真寺，那天都有谁在场？

sentences.en: That mosque, we got from every race.
sentences.zh: 那座清真寺里，我们有各种族裔的人。

sentences.en: From Malaysia, from Philippines, from Afghanistan, from every, every sort of country.
sentences.zh: 来自马来西亚、菲律宾、阿富汗，来自各种各样的国家。

sentences.en: My colleague Damien Cave spoke with Abdul Aziz, who was praying at the Linwood Mosque with his four sons, when he heard gunshots.
sentences.zh: 我的同事达米恩·凯夫采访了阿卜杜勒·阿齐兹，他当时正和四个儿子在林伍德清真寺祈祷，这时他听到了枪声。

sentences.en: Aziz ran toward the shots, grabbing the first thing he could find, a credit card machine, which he flung at the attacker.
sentences.zh: 阿齐兹冲向枪声来源，抓起手边能找到的第一样东西——一台信用卡机，并把它扔向了袭击者。

sentences.en: The shooter dropped a gun, and Aziz picked it up.
sentences.zh: 枪手掉了一把枪，阿齐兹捡了起来。

sentences.en: And I picked up the gun, and I checked that they had no bullets, and I was screaming to the guys, come here, I'm here.
sentences.zh: 我捡起枪，检查了一下发现没有子弹，我就冲着那些人喊，到这儿来，我在这儿。

sentences.en: I just wanted to put more focus on me, then go inside the masjid, but unfortunately, he just got himself to the masjid.
sentences.zh: 我只是想把注意力吸引到我身上，然后再进清真寺，但不幸的是，他还是进了清真寺。

sentences.en: Then I heard more shooting sound, and I see the shooting inside the masjid.
sentences.zh: 然后我听到了更多的枪声，我看到清真寺里在开枪。

sentences.en: Moments later, when the gunman went to his car to retrieve more weapons,
sentences.zh: 片刻之后，当枪手回到车里去拿更多武器时，

sentences.en: Aziz followed him.
sentences.zh: 阿齐兹跟了上去。

sentences.en: More gun on his car, he tried to get more gun from his car.
sentences.zh: 他车里还有枪，他试图从车里拿更多的枪。

sentences.en: When he see me, I'm chasing with a gun, he sat on his car.
sentences.zh: 当他看到我拿着枪追过来时，他坐进了车里。

sentences.en: And I just got that gun and threw on his window like an arrow, and blasted his window.
sentences.zh: 我拿着那把枪像箭一样扔向他的车窗，击碎了他的窗户。

sentences.en: And he thought, I probably shot him or something, and the guns come back, and just drive off.
sentences.zh: 他以为我可能射中了他什么的，枪也回来了，他就开车逃跑了。

sentences.en: Aziz used the gun to shatter the gunman's car window, which many witnesses believe is what prompted him to speed away, rather than re-enter the mosque and kill more people.
sentences.zh: 阿齐兹用枪击碎了枪手的车窗，许多目击者认为这促使他加速逃离，而不是重新进入清真寺杀害更多人。

sentences.en: Anybody who did the same thing, if you was there, you would have done the same thing.
sentences.zh: 任何做同样事情的人，如果你当时在那里，你也会做同样的事。

sentences.en: Have you, um, can I ask you?
sentences.zh: 你，嗯，我可以问你吗？

sentences.en: Minutes later, video shows the suspect being pulled by police from his car, two and a half miles down the road, where two more guns and homemade explosives were also found.
sentences.zh: 几分钟后，视频显示嫌疑人在两英里半外的路上被警察从车里拖出，车内还发现了另外两把枪和自制爆炸物。

sentences.en: I want to speak specifically about the firearms used in this terrorist act.
sentences.zh: 我想专门谈谈这次恐怖袭击中使用的枪支。

sentences.en: There were two semi-automatic weapons and two shotguns.
sentences.zh: 有两把半自动武器和两把霰弹枪。

sentences.en: On Sunday, New Zealand's Prime Minister, Jacinda Ardern, said that the suspect, an Australian citizen, would be tried in New Zealand,
sentences.zh: 周日，新西兰总理杰辛达·阿德恩表示，这名澳大利亚籍嫌疑人将在新西兰受审，

sentences.en: and that her government would meet today to discuss the country's gun laws.
sentences.zh: 她的政府将于今天开会讨论该国的枪支法。

sentences.en: I can tell you one thing right now, our gun laws will change.
sentences.zh: 我现在可以告诉你一件事，我们的枪支法将会改变。

sentences.en: Funerals for all 50 victims are expected to be held in the coming days.
sentences.zh: 预计所有50名遇难者的葬礼将在未来几天内举行。

sentences.en: As the police commissioner confirmed this morning,
sentences.zh: 正如警察局长今天上午所证实的，

sentences.en: 50 people have been killed and 34 people remain in Christchurch Hospital,
sentences.zh: 已有50人遇难，34人仍留在基督城医院，

sentences.en: 12 of them in the intensive care unit in critical condition.
sentences.zh: 其中12人在重症监护室，情况危急。

sentences.en: A four-year-old girl remains in a critical condition at Starship Hospital in Auckland.
sentences.zh: 一名四岁女孩在奥克兰星舰医院情况依然危急。

sentences.en: Islamic burial rituals typically require bodies to be buried as soon as possible, and usually within 24 hours.
sentences.zh: 伊斯兰葬礼仪式通常要求遗体尽快下葬，通常在24小时内。

sentences.en: But New Zealand authorities say that the process of identifying the victims and returning them to their families could take several more days.
sentences.zh: 但新西兰当局表示，确认遇难者身份并将其归还给家属的过程可能还需要几天时间。

sentences.en: It is the expectation that all bodies will be returned to families by Wednesday.
sentences.zh: 预计所有遗体将在周三前归还给家属。

sentences.en: I want to finish by saying that while the nation grapples with a form of grief and anger that we have not experienced before, we are seeking answers.
sentences.zh: 最后我想说，虽然全国都在经历一种我们从未体验过的悲痛和愤怒，但我们正在寻求答案。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Kevin, I want to talk to you about the moments before this mass shooting began.
sentences.zh: 凯文，我想和你谈谈这次大规模枪击事件开始前的时刻。

sentences.en: What do you know about those?
sentences.zh: 关于那些你了解多少？

sentences.en: Well, what we know comes from a video that was live-streamed on Facebook while this was all happening by the gunman.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们所知道的来自于枪手在这一切发生时在 Facebook 上直播的一段视频。

sentences.en: He taped himself in the car on his way over to the mosque, listening to music, talking.
sentences.zh: 他录下了自己在车里前往清真寺的路上，听着音乐，说着话。

sentences.en: And right before he gets out of the car and goes into the mosque, he pauses and says, remember, lads, subscribe to PewDiePie.
sentences.zh: 就在他下车进入清真寺之前，他停顿了一下说，记住，伙计们，订阅 PewDiePie。

sentences.en: And when I heard that, I just, like, I knew, oh, this is something different than we're used to.
sentences.zh: 当我听到那个时，我只是，就像，我知道，哦，这和我们习惯的不一样。

sentences.en: What do you mean?
sentences.zh: 你是什么意思？

sentences.en: What is PewDiePie?
sentences.zh: 什么是 PewDiePie？

sentences.en: And why does that reference matter?
sentences.zh: 为什么那个引用很重要？

sentences.en: So PewDiePie is this really popular YouTube personality.
sentences.zh: PewDiePie 是 YouTube 上非常受欢迎的网红。

sentences.en: He has the most subscribers of anyone on YouTube.
sentences.zh: 他是 YouTube 上订阅人数最多的人。

sentences.en: Some people think he's offensive.
sentences.zh: 有些人认为他很冒犯人。

sentences.en: Some people really like him.
sentences.zh: 有些人真的很喜欢他。

sentences.en: He's got this whole fan base.
sentences.zh: 他有庞大的粉丝群。

sentences.en: And a few months ago, his fans started sort of spamming this phrase, subscribe to PewDiePie, in an attempt to kind of keep him from being eclipsed by another account
sentences.zh: 几个月前，他的粉丝开始在网上刷“订阅 PewDiePie”这句话，试图阻止他的订阅数被另一个账号超越，

sentences.en: that was going to have more followers than him.
sentences.zh: 那个账号的粉丝数即将超过他。

sentences.en: So it sort of became this competition.
sentences.zh: 所以这演变成了一场竞争。

sentences.en: Then it became this joke.
sentences.zh: 然后它变成了一个笑话。

sentences.en: And now subscribe to PewDiePie is just kind of like a thing that people say on certain parts of the internet.
sentences.zh: 现在“订阅 PewDiePie”在互联网的某些角落已经成了一种口头禅。

sentences.en: It's just kind of like a signifier.
sentences.zh: 它就像一个符号。

sentences.en: Like, I understand the internet.
sentences.zh: 比如，我懂互联网。

sentences.en: You understand the internet.
sentences.zh: 你懂互联网。

sentences.en: This is how we're going to signal to each other that we understand the internet.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们向彼此发出信号，表明我们懂互联网的方式。

sentences.en: And this is what he's signaling in saying that.
sentences.zh: 这就是他通过说那句话所发出的信号。

sentences.en: Yeah, so I have that in my head.
sentences.zh: 是的，所以我脑子里有这个印象。

sentences.en: And then I see all these other signs that something is weirdly kind of internet-y about all of this.
sentences.zh: 然后我看到了所有其他迹象，表明这一切都有一种奇怪的“互联网味”。

sentences.en: Like, there's this post on 8chan, which is kind of like a scummy message board that lots of extremists and weirdos go on.
sentences.zh: 比如，8chan 上有这个帖子，那是一个有很多极端分子和怪人出没的低俗留言板。

sentences.en: And in the post, the gunman links to the Facebook stream before it happens.
sentences.zh: 在帖子里，枪手在事件发生前就放出了 Facebook 直播的链接。

sentences.en: The Facebook stream that he will record of the massacre.
sentences.zh: 他将要录制大屠杀过程的 Facebook 直播。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And then he pastes a bunch of links to copies of his manifesto.
